name: Model Compression, Quantization & Acceleration
description: Reducing model size and latency without sacrificing accuracy: Post-Training Quantization (PTQ), Quantization-Aware Training (QAT), Structured/Unstructured Pruning, Knowledge Distillation, TensorRT, and hardware compilation.

subskills.name: Post-Training Quantization (PTQ - INT8 / FP16)
subskills.description: Quantization mechanics (scale, zero-point, dynamic vs static quantization), calibration datasets, and converting FP32 weights to INT8.

subskills.name: Quantization-Aware Training (QAT)
subskills.description: Simulating fake quantization during backpropagation, straight-through estimators (STE), and retaining full accuracy at INT8 precision.

subskills.name: Weight Pruning (Structured & Unstructured)
subskills.description: Magnitude-based pruning, L1-norm channel pruning, structured pruning for hardware acceleration, iterative prune-and-finetune schedules.

subskills.name: Knowledge Distillation (Teacher-Student Frameworks)
subskills.description: Soft targets, temperature scaling, Kullback-Leibler distillation loss, feature map distillation, and training compact student models.

subskills.name: NVIDIA TensorRT GPU Acceleration & Kernel Fusion
subskills.description: Building TensorRT engines from ONNX, layer fusion, kernel auto-tuning, precision calibration (FP16/INT8), and execution profiles.

subskills.name: Intel OpenVINO & CPU Inference Acceleration
subskills.description: Optimizing neural networks for x86 Intel CPUs, VNNI / AVX-512 instructions, OpenVINO Model Optimizer, and asynchronous execution.

subskills.name: Model Compilation (torch.compile & Apache TVM)
subskills.description: PyTorch 2.0 torch.compile, TorchDynamo, AOTAutograd, Inductor backend, graph capture, and Apache TVM tensor compilation.

subskills.name: Low-Rank Weight Factorization & LoRA Mechanics
subskills.description: Decomposing heavy weight matrices using SVD or low-rank adapters (LoRA / QLoRA rank matrices A and B), parameter reduction.

subskills.name: Memory Bandwidth, Cache Locality & Kernel Tuning
subskills.description: Analyzing memory-bound vs compute-bound layers (Roofline model), SRAM cache utilization, and FlashAttention I/O awareness.

cv.signal: Optimized neural network inference via INT8 Quantization and TensorRT compilation, reducing latency by 4x

linkedin.signal: Model Quantization, TensorRT, and Model Compression endorsements

assessment.signal: Passes Model Compression, Quantization & Acceleration Assessment

junior.description: Applies post-training dynamic quantization (PTQ) and compiles standard PyTorch models with torch.compile.

mid.description: Trains student models via Knowledge Distillation, prunes weights with iterative finetuning, and implements QAT fake quantization.

senior.description: Builds optimized TensorRT engines with custom layer fusions and optimizes hardware memory bandwidth using the Roofline model.
